acoustic_layer_stack — ACOUSTICS ultrasonic op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.acoustic_layer_stack(layers=(('silicon', 0.0001), ('sio2', 2e-06)), substrate='silicon', couplant='water', allow_unverified=False) (to call the implementation directly, import ultrasound; ultrasound.acoustic_layer_stack(layers=(('silicon', 0.0001), ('sio2', 2e-06)), substrate='silicon', couplant='water', allow_unverified=False); from the registry, opsacoustics.get("acoustic_layer_stack"))

Usage

Layered stack for normal-incidence pulse-echo: couplant, layers (material, thickness in m) from the top, and a half-space substrate (table).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

layers は [(材料, 厚さ [m]), ...](上から)。材料は表の名前(acoustic_material_table)か {"rho", "c", "alpha0", "alpha_n", "name"} の dict。層は 0 枚でもよい(結合液と基板の 1 界面)。返りの interfaces は上から couplant|layer0, layer0|layer1, …, layerN-1|substrate の名前、t_interfaces は最初の界面からの往復時間 [s] で 2 Σ d_j / c_j、depth はその深さ [m]。

Raises ValueError: 厚さが 0 以下・1 m 超・非有限、未知の材料、確かめていない材料(allow_unverified 無し)、ρ・c が 0 以下、減衰が負、層が 256 枚超。
